IncidentBot: [PAGER] kvcache OOM spike detected on pool hosted-gpu-12 — 5xx rate rising, evictions failing. Logs: https://internal/logs/abc123 :rotating_light:

alex: Oncall here, ack. Pulling logs and dashboards now. Which customers hit?

maria: I'm seeing sustained KV cache growth from a few longprompt sessions. Continuous batching holding onto KV windows -> memory climb. Two tenants with high error spikes: acme-inc, midwest-health.

alex: ok. Immediate mitigation: throttle prefetch and pause continuous batching on that pool. SRE, can you apply?

sre_jordan: applying temporary throttle now.

sre_jordan: Command run:
```
rcctl apply-config --pool hosted-gpu-12 --set prefetch.max_prefetch=2 --set batcher.continuous=false
```

sre_jordan: rolled to all shards in pool. Deploy ID: deploy/11823

deploy-bot: rollout complete to pool hosted-gpu-12 (deploy/11823) — 6/6 shards updated :white_check_mark:

maria: disabling continuous batching dropped the resident KV bytes quickly. Heap on shard-3 down from 92GB -> 48GB in 40s. Latency improving.

lina: customer impact: acme-inc reports 25% failed requests, midwest-health had 2 5-min timeouts. We should notify support and start postmortem.

alex: noted. I pinged support with initial impact summary. We'll keep throttle in place while engineering prepares a config hotfix.

maria: root cause draft: longprompt sessions with repetitive prefix expand cause KV window growth; continuous batching pooled these across requests and prevented early eviction. Proposed fix: cap pretrained KV window before caching and add age-based eviction for infrequent sessions.

maria: opened PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/452

alex: can we hotpatch a config that limits max_cached_seq=2048 and enables aggressive_eviction=true?

maria: yes. I'll push a hotpatch to the config service.

sre_jordan: applying hotpatch to pool:
```
rcctl apply-config --pool hosted-gpu-12 --set kvcache.max_cached_seq=2048 --set kvcache.eviction_policy=age_based_aggressive
```

sre_jordan: hotpatch rolled (ID: hotpatch/987). Monitoring.

maria: after hotpatch, resident memory steady ~38GB on all shards. 5xx rates down to baseline. Keeping continuous batching disabled for 10m to watch.

alex: thanks. Prep notes for next oncall (ravi):
- Incident: KV cache OOM spike due to longprompt amplification under continuous batching
- Mitigations applied: prefetch.max_prefetch=2, continuous batching disabled, hotpatch set max_cached_seq=2048 + age_based_eviction
- Customer impact: acme-inc (25% failures), midwest-health (2 x 5m timeouts), ~1200 requests impacted
- Links: logs https://internal/logs/abc123, PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/452, deploy/11823, hotpatch/987

alex: handing off to @ravi for overnight monitoring at 22:00 UTC. Please escalate if 5xx > baseline for more than 5m. :handshake:

ravi: acked, will monitor dashboards and keep slack updates every 30m. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll follow up with a full RCA doc tomorrow morning and propose a rollout plan for permanent batcher changes.

alex: closing pager for now — mitigation successful, moving to recovery. Thanks everyone :tada:
